title: althaea thuringiaca
intro: Althaea thuringiaca, commonly known as marsh mallow, is a perennial plant species in the family Malvaceae, native to Europe and Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and soothing digestive issues. Therapeutically, Althaea thuringiaca is known for its demulcent and emollient properties, which help to protect and moisturize mucous membranes. The plant's bioactive constituents include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
